name: tokenlens
description: TokenLens v2 —— 多供应商 LLM API 网关：OpenAI 兼容入口、渠道路由与故障转移、钱包计费、订阅与限额、链路追踪。目标结构与迁移纪律见 docs/project-structure-refactoring.md

scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/db && bun --env-file=../../.env x drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.test:e2e: cd apps/gateway && bun x vitest run -c ../../e2e/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:real: cd apps/gateway && bun x vitest run -c ../../e2e/vitest.real.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: cd apps/gateway && bun x vitest run -c ../../e2e/vitest.smoke.config.ts
